AUX retains OD2.8 bore: prepare its 26 AWG PH wire bundle with a jacket/sleeve to measured OD2.9..3.1; do not clamp exposed individual conductors. Printed TPU grip requires coupon and pull/flex testing.

retention_collars.description: 2:1 heat-shrink tube; expanded ID8 mm; cut length8 mm; four individual collars retain the two TPU halves
retention_collars.process: Slide from loose PCB-end wires before soldering. Shrink around assembled TPU boots before inserting comb in rigid case. Do not overheat cable jacket.

cable_source_evidence.inspection: Manufacturer drawing visually checked; source supplied by electrical procurement. Stock status is maintained by the procurement BOM, not this mechanical contract.

two_p5_plug_candidate.status: Conditional candidate; at the stated 3.5 mm minimum outlet it will not clear a 3.8 mm jacket. Sample-gauge actual outlet >=3.8 mm before use; supplier stock must be confirmed separately.

print.rigid_material: PETG or ASA; prototype defaults PETG
print.case_orientation: Base exterior bottom on bed; lid exterior roof on bed. Clean optional slicer support from internal selector guide ledges.
print.comb_orientation: Each split face on bed; upper/lower print-oriented exports supplied.
print.warning: Fit tolerances depend on printer/material; print included insert/comb coupon first. Not watertight.
print.selector_orientation: Fork upright with brim; thumb upside down with outer face on bed. Print-oriented files supplied.

selector.thumb_screw: M2 x 6 mm, head <=4.0 x 1.8, one additional short M2 insert
selector.note: Official ALPS actuator width1.5, stroke2 per step, body15x3.5x3.5. Fork socket width1.9 gives nominal0.20 per side. Adjustable clamped coupling accommodates model/printed datum variation without moving exterior scale or guides.
selector.library_model_fit_note: Only an observed library-model fit. Official public drawing does not dimension absolute actuator X to the footprint datum; adjust the actual assembled unit before tightening.
selector.assembly_alignment: Place actual switch in an inner detent (label1 or2), align thumb with that label, allow fork to locate on actuator within the X slots, then tighten existing M2x6 while holding alignment. Verify all four detents without binding.

assembly_population.note: These four native connector models are reference-only at direct-wire solder pads. Do not assemble the library connector bodies; use the approved cable harness. SW1 is manual TH.
